# Node settings

Settings of the daemon on one node, in `/etc/pve/nodes/<node>/pve-rclone-backup.cfg`. The file is optional: a missing file or setting means the default. Write one `key: value` per line; lines starting with `#` are comments.

The daemon reads the file when it starts, so restart it after a change: `systemctl restart pve-rclone-backupd`. If the file is invalid, the daemon uses the defaults and `pve-rclone-backup status` reports the problem.

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`staging-dir`](#staging-dir) | `/var/lib/pve-rclone-backup/staging` | Directory for restore and fetch staging on this node. |
| [`staging-reserve`](#staging-reserve) | `10G` | Free space that staging must always leave on its filesystem. |
| [`upload-workers`](#upload-workers) | `2` | Maximum concurrent uploads on this node across all storages. |
| [`scan-interval`](#scan-interval) | `15m` | Interval of reconcile scans of source storages for missed archives. |
| [`inotify`](#inotify) | `1` | Watch source storages for finished archives. |
| [`restore-ionice`](#restore-ionice) | `best-effort:4` | I/O scheduling class used for restore processes. |

## `staging-dir`

**Staging Directory.** Directory for restore and fetch staging on this node.

- Value: text matching the regular expression `/[^\s]*`, at most 255 characters.
- Default: `/var/lib/pve-rclone-backup/staging`

## `staging-reserve`

**Staging Reserve.** Free space that staging must always leave on its filesystem.

- Value: a size in bytes with an optional binary unit `K`, `M`, `G` or `T`, such as `512M`.
- Default: `10G`

## `upload-workers`

**Upload Workers.** Maximum concurrent uploads on this node across all storages.

- Value: an integer from 1 to 16.
- Default: `2`

## `scan-interval`

**Scan Interval.** Interval of reconcile scans of source storages for missed archives.

- Value: a duration: a number followed by `s`, `m`, `h`, `d` or `w` (seconds to weeks), such as `7d`.
- Default: `15m`

## `inotify`

**Inotify.** Watch source storages for finished archives.

- Value: `1` (yes) or `0` (no).
- Default: `1`

## `restore-ionice`

**Restore I/O Priority.** I/O scheduling class used for restore processes.

- Value: one of `best-effort:0`, `best-effort:4`, `best-effort:7`, `idle`.
- Default: `best-effort:4`
